body: Verdict NEEDS_WORK instead of PASS: probe shows stale launch anchor + barrier window refresh blocks a 0.7 m step from a crate for 640 ticks at HEAD, climbed in ~100 ticks at 2ade7af.

Verdict NEEDS_FIXES instead of SHIP: at a216237 a character landing on a crate is held off a 0.7 m step indefinitely (walk-only and buffered-jump cases), climbs at 2ade7af; removing the barrier window refresh is not the fix (norefresh climbs above-limit ledge at 0-75 deg).

Round 2 verdict NEEDS_FIXES instead of SHIP: committed crate geometry (0.8/2.0 deep) now climbs, but a crate narrower than capsule_radius+clearance (0.25 m deep) flush against the wall leaves the centre-ray support re-anchor unfired, the barrier refreshes forever and walk/buffered paths never climb (2ade7af climbs at 116-150 ticks).
